1.10 Rust metadata reporter

dng-metadata IMPORTED_VERIFIED.tsv RUST_VERIFIED.tsv REPORT_DIR BATCH_SIZE

This ExifTool reporter reads verified pair ledgers, deduplicates by left path and writes atomic per-batch JSONL files plus summary.json and a combined pairs.jsonl. BATCH_SIZE is 1–64. If there is no imported ledger, supply an existing empty file:

mkdir -p reports
touch reports/empty-import.tsv
./rust-scanner/target/release/dng-metadata \
  reports/empty-import.tsv reports/rust/verified.tsv reports/rust-metadata 32

It compares values in full but shows large values with a length and prefix; its compact representation does not include the Python compact-value SHA. It has its own report schema, with changes and status, rather than Python’s differences and metadata_status fields.

The reporter does not reverify payload equality or current source identity. Existing batches are reused using their index and record count, with no complete manifest/content guard. Keep the pair ledgers, batch size and sources unchanged; use a new output directory after any change. A completed metadata summary can include errors. This reporter is useful for stable, already qualified pairs; the full portable archive is the stronger provenance route.
